text:
sre-bot: Incident created — elevated error rate observed for paging endpoints after 2026-03-15 09:12 UTC. Error spike: 502/503 responses. Automated detection rule tripped. 

jane: seeing the spike, looks correlated with this morning's deploy (sdk-server v3.12). Canary shows 30% error rate. 

omar: confirming, canary on us-east-1 shows stream handshake failures and HTTP resets. Repro with client v2.8.1. 

li: stack traces point to new header shim code in header-negotiator module. Probably a case-sensitive header rename. 

oncall-maya: rolling to oncall. I'll start mitigation. @eng-release can you pause the rollout and flip any kill-switch? 

eng-release: pausing rollout now. Flipped feature flag deploy.header_shim.enabled -> false in FF service. 

sre-bot: Auto-scaling actions paused. Alerting muted for lower severity.

jane: after flag flip error rate dropped to ~8% in canary; but some legacy clients still hitting errors. 

omar: customers using streaming SDK v2.8.1 are affected — handshake fails when header 'x-rw-client' capitalized differently. 

support-alex: support queue: 12 tickets from high-value customers (SAML customers) complaining about streaming disconnects. Logged CSAT risk. 

pm-sam: what's the blast radius? estimate affected requests per minute vs total? 

li: quick numbers: traffic in canary cluster ~12k rpm, failing ~3.6k rpm at peak. Global backbone shows failure rate peaked ~4.5% of total paging calls. 

oncall-maya: prioritize rollback if feature flag isn't clean. Can we hotfix header-negotiator to accept both casings? 

eng-release: we can push a 1-line tolerance patch but it needs canary. Given impact, recommend rollback of sdk-server v3.12 to v3.11 in canary, then full rollback. 

jane: agree. Rolling back canary now. Command:
```
rolloutctl set-version sdk-server --env canary --version v3.11
```

sre-bot: Rollback initiated by eng-release at 09:29 UTC. Expected steady-state in ~3m. 

omar: monitoring handshake success — improving. Can we validate with a client test harness? I ran the compatibility test and both casing work again. 

support-alex: customer updates queued. Notifying affected accounts (top 5) now. 

pm-sam: need to surface postmortem for leadership and PS. Include timeline + mitigation + recommended SDK patch. 

li: action items: 1) backport header tolerance to v3.12 (patch) 2) add regression test for header casing and handshake 3) better canary traffic split heuristics (maybe 5% for first 10m) 4) run quick compatibility sweep of clients before rollout. 

oncall-maya: temporary mitigation complete? ERR rate down to 0.3% global. 

jane: yes, canary rollback shows stable. Proceeding to rollback production rollout. 

eng-release: production rollback started. 

sre-bot: Prod rollback completed at 09:47 UTC. Post-rollback status: success rate normalizing. 

support-alex: notified all 12 customers directly; CS notified of potential credits. 

pm-sam: preparing customer-facing incident summary after SOC sign-off. 

li: creating PR for patch with tests: header-negotiator: accept header names case-insensitively and log mismatches as warnings. 

omar: follow-up: confirm SDK client release notes and add deprecation warnings for any header changes. 

jane: final note: consider adding an automated compatibility gate that runs downstream client smoke tests during canary. 

oncall-maya: handing back to triage. I'll own the firebreak follow-up tomorrow. 

sre-bot: Incident closed — mitigation successful. Please file an incident report: tag=paging, root_cause=header-shim-backcompat, mitigation=rollback+kill-switch, severity=sev2. 

jane: thanks everyone. good catch and quick kill-switch flip. :thumbsup:
